faculty.name: Duane Wegener
faculty.summary: Studies how attitudes and beliefs form and change, focusing on information processing and its consequences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究态度和信念的形成与变化，重点关注信息处理及其后果。

faculty.name: Riana Brown
faculty.summary: Studies how people respond to social problems like social inequality and climate change, focusing on communication strategies to promote social change.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何应对社会问题（如社会不平等和气候变化），重点关注促进社会变革的沟通策略。

faculty.name: Gyeongcheol Cho
faculty.summary: Develops quantitative methods to explore relationships between human behavioral, psychological, and biological variables, using factor analyses, structural equation modeling, and interpretable.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发定量方法以探索人类行为、心理和生物变量之间的关系，使用因子分析、结构方程模型和可解释的机器学习。

faculty.name: Laurence Coutellier
faculty.summary: Studies the prefrontal cortex's role in anxiety, executive function, and social impairments using behavioral assays and transgenic mice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究前额叶皮层在焦虑、执行功能和社会障碍中的作用，使用行为测试和转基因小鼠。

faculty.name: Michael DeKay
faculty.summary: Studies judgment and decision-making, focusing on risky-choice framing effects and perceptions of energy use.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究判断与决策，重点关注风险选择框架效应和能源使用感知。

faculty.name: Ido Erev
faculty.summary: Studies decision-making processes, particularly how people's choices are influenced by past experiences and incentives, using descriptive models and experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究决策过程，特别是人们的选择如何受到过去经验及激励的影响，使用描述性模型和实验方法。

faculty.name: Kentaro Fujita
faculty.summary: Studies self-control failures and decision-making processes, particularly why people make choices that undermine their goals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自我控制失败和决策过程，特别是人们为何做出损害自身目标的选择。

faculty.name: John Gibbs
faculty.summary: Studies cross-cultural sociomoral development, parental socialization, empathy, and antisocial behavior, developing assessment measures and prevention programs.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究跨文化道德发展、父母社会化、同理心和反社会行为，开发评估量表和预防项目。

faculty.name: Julie Golomb
faculty.summary: Studies how visual attention, memory, and eye movements interact to influence perception and behavior using human behavioral and computational cognitive neuroscience techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉注意、记忆和眼动如何相互作用影响知觉和行为，使用人类行为和计算认知神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Kurt Gray
faculty.summary: Studies moral psychology and how to reduce political divides, using lab and center-based research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究道德心理学，探索如何减少政治分歧，通过实验室和中心研究。

faculty.name: Richard Jagacinski
faculty.summary: Studies rhythmic attention in athletic and musical performance, attention and memory in vehicular control, and perceptual-motor skills in older adults.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动和音乐表现中的节律注意力、车辆控制中的注意力和记忆以及老年人的知觉-运动技能。

faculty.name: Peter Kvam
faculty.summary: Studies how people make complex, dynamic decisions, using machine learning and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何做出复杂动态的决策，使用机器学习和计算模型。

faculty.name: Andrew Leber
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive control, focusing on how humans selectively attend to relevant stimuli and ignore irrelevant ones, using behavioral studies and fMRI.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知控制，关注人类如何选择性地注意相关信息并忽略无关信息，使用行为研究和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）。

faculty.name: Luc Lecavalier
faculty.summary: Studies diagnosis and assessment of autism spectrum disorder and intellectual disabilities, focusing on behavior and psychiatric problems in children.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自闭症谱系障碍和智力障碍的诊断与评估，关注儿童的行为和精神健康问题。

faculty.name: Kathryn Lenz
faculty.summary: Studies the role of hormones and immune cells in brain development and neuropsychiatric disorders, using pharmacological and behavioral manipulations in rodents.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究激素和免疫细胞在大脑发育和神经精神障碍中的作用，使用药理学和行为操作在啮齿动物中进行研究。

faculty.name: Benedetta Leuner
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of pregnancy, stress, and hormones on maternal behavior and brain health, using preclinical models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究妊娠、压力和激素对母性行为和脑健康的影响，使用预临床模型。

faculty.name: Hsin-Hung Li
faculty.summary: Studies the computational and neural processes of decision-making, attention, and working memory using computational modeling and neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究决策、注意和工作记忆的认知和神经过程，使用计算建模和神经成像方法。

faculty.name: Lisa Libby
faculty.summary: Studies how subjective perceptions influence cognition, emotion, and behavior, using visual perspective in mental imagery.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究主观知觉如何影响认知、情绪和行为，并使用心理成像中的视觉视角进行研究。

faculty.name: Kristen Lindquist
faculty.summary: Studies the psychological and neural basis of emotions, moods, and feelings, using social cognition, physiology, and neuroscience methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪、情绪状态和感觉的心理和神经基础，使用社会认知、生理学和神经科学方法。

faculty.name: John Opfer
faculty.summary: Studies how children develop numerical concepts and understanding of proportional magnitude, using cognitive and educational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何发展数概念和比例大小的理解，使用认知和教育方法。

faculty.name: David Osher
faculty.summary: Studies the relationship between brain connectivity, neural function, and behavior through computational modeling, focusing on attention and high-level visual perception.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑连接性、神经功能与行为之间的关系，通过计算建模聚焦于注意力和高级视觉知觉。

faculty.name: Jolynn Pek
faculty.summary: Studies quantifying uncertainty in statistical results and methods for practical application in study design and data analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究统计结果中的不确定性及其在研究设计和数据分析中的应用方法。

faculty.name: Stephen Petrill
faculty.summary: Studies how genetics and the environment influence the development of cognitive skills related to reading, mathematics, and language, using quantitative genetic, molecular genetic, behavioral.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究遗传和环境如何影响阅读、数学和语言认知技能的发展，采用定量遗传学、分子遗传学、行为学、认知学和神经影像学视角。

faculty.name: Alexander Petrov
faculty.summary: Studies how relational processing and analogy making contribute to human cognition, using computational models and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究关系处理和类比推理在人类认知中的作用，采用计算模型和行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Richard Petty
faculty.summary: Studies the factors influencing beliefs, attitudes, and behaviors, particularly the role of meta-cognitive and implicit factors in persuasion.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究信念、态度和行为的变化因素，特别是元认知和隐性因素在说服中的作用。

faculty.name: Roger Ratcliff
faculty.summary: Studies decision-making processes and reaction times using sequential sampling models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究决策过程和反应时，使用顺序采样模型。

faculty.name: Leslie Rudy
faculty.summary: Teaches psychology and clinical skills, focusing on evidence-based practices and individualized learning strategies.
faculty.summary_zh: 教授心理学和临床技能，注重基于证据的教学实践和个性化学习策略。

faculty.name: Zeynep Saygin
faculty.summary: Studies how brain areas become responsible for specific cognitive functions, using neuroimaging and computational methods in development and clinical disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑区域如何承担特定认知功能，使用神经成像和计算方法在发展和临床障碍中的应用。

faculty.name: Sarah Schoppe-Sullivan
faculty.summary: Studies coparenting relationships, father-child dynamics, and the impact of children's behavior on family interactions, focusing on young children's social-emotional development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究共育儿关系、父亲与孩子的互动以及儿童行为对家庭关系的影响，重点关注幼儿的社会情感发展。

faculty.name: Megha Sehgal
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of habit formation and contextual memory integration in the brain.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑中习惯形成和情境记忆整合的神经机制。

faculty.name: Brynn Sherman
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain supports the formation of unique memories and abstracts general regularities, using neuroimaging and neural network models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何支持形成独特记忆和抽象一般规律，使用神经成像和神经网络模型。

faculty.name: Vladimir Sloutsky
faculty.summary: Studies how infants and young children form categories and generalize knowledge, using experimental methods with pre-linguistic infants, toddlers, and preschoolers.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿如何形成类别并进行知识泛化，使用预语言婴儿、学步儿和学龄前儿童的实验方法。

faculty.name: Steven Spencer
faculty.summary: Studies how implicit processes affect stereotyping and prejudice, particularly how threats to the self-concept lead to biased thoughts and behaviors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究潜意识过程如何影响刻板印象和偏见，特别是威胁自我概念如何导致有偏见的思维和行为。

faculty.name: Marc J. Tassé
faculty.summary: Studies intellectual disability, autism spectrum disorder, and related neurodevelopmental disorders, focusing on co-occurring psychiatric disorders and adaptive behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究智力障碍、自闭症谱系障碍及相关神经发育障碍，重点关注共发的精神障碍和适应行为。

faculty.name: Brandon Turner
faculty.summary: Studies how selective attention causes cognitive inertia, a pattern of information search, and how curated information can harm or distort learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究选择性注意如何导致认知惯性，即信息搜索的模式，以及如何使受curated信息损害或扭曲学习。

faculty.name: Trisha Van Zandt
faculty.summary: Studies the quantitative modeling of human information processing systems, neural networks, and memory, focusing on how information flows and is transformed during cognitive tasks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类信息处理系统的定量建模、神经网络和记忆，关注信息在认知任务中的流动和转换。

faculty.name: Dylan Wagner
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain encodes social relationships, including friends, fictional characters, and AI companions, using neuroimaging and naturalistic social tasks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何编码人际关系，包括朋友、虚构人物和人工智能伴侣，使用神经成像和自然社会任务。

faculty.name: Laura Wagner
faculty.summary: Studies how children acquire language, focusing on their understanding of temporal and event semantics, and social indexical meanings.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童的语言习得，特别是时间与事件语义以及社会语用意义的理解。

faculty.name: Katie Walton
faculty.summary: Studies interventions for building early social-communication skills in individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorders, examining individual and family factors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自闭症谱系障碍早期社交沟通技能干预措施，考察个体和家庭因素。

faculty.name: Baldwin Way
faculty.summary: Studies how social factors influence health through neurochemical signals, focusing on stress reactivity, drug action, and immune system modulation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会因素如何通过神经化学信号影响健康，重点关注压力反应、药物作用和免疫系统调节。

faculty.name: Sami Yousif
faculty.summary: Studies spatial cognition and visual perception as case studies of mental representation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究空间认知和视觉感知作为心智表征的案例研究。

faculty.name: Amy Brunell
faculty.summary: Studies the role of narcissism in social contexts, including leadership, decision-making, and relationship behaviors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自恋在社会情境中的作用，包括领导力、决策和人际关系行为。

faculty.name: Patrick Carroll
faculty.summary: Studies how and why people revise self-views in response to social feedback, and how such changes affect mental health and relational satisfaction.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何以及为何根据社会反馈调整自我观点，并探讨这些变化对心理健康和关系满意度的影响。

faculty.name: Christopher Daddis
faculty.summary: Studies how adolescents construct boundaries of personal and parental authority, focusing on peer influence and voluntary disclosure.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年如何构建个人与父母的权威边界，重点关注同伴影响和自愿披露。

faculty.name: Julie Hupp
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn words from prosodic cues, using experiments with adults and children.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何从声调线索中学习新词，使用成人和儿童的实验方法。

faculty.name: Melissa Jungers
faculty.summary: Studies how people communicate in auditory domains, focusing on memory for complex auditory sequences, perception and production systems, and language and music parallels.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人在听觉领域中的交流方式，关注复杂听觉序列的记忆、感知与生产系统以及语言与音乐的相似性。

faculty.name: Fabio Leite
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes, analyzing response time and accuracy in decision-making tasks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程，分析决策任务中的反应时间和准确性。

faculty.name: Delwin Lindsey
faculty.summary: Studies color vision, including neural channels, molecular genetics, and early development in infants, combining empirical and computational approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究颜色视觉，包括神经通道、分子遗传学和婴儿早期发展，结合实证和计算方法。

faculty.name: Philip Mazzocco
faculty.summary: Studies beliefs and opinions related to marginalized populations, focusing on racial ideology and colorblindness.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究边缘化群体相关的信念和观点，特别是种族意识形态和肤色盲视。

faculty.name: Bradley Okdie
faculty.summary: Studies how new technologies influence social interactions and psychological phenomena.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究新技术如何影响社会互动和心理现象。

faculty.name: Nikole Patson
faculty.summary: Studies how adults process and represent plurals in language comprehension, using experimental psychology methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成人如何在语言理解中处理和表示复数，采用实验心理学方法。

faculty.name: Chris Robinson
faculty.summary: Studies how infants, children, and adults integrate multisensory information for tasks like word learning and categorization.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿、儿童和成人如何整合多感官信息以完成词汇学习和分类等任务。

faculty.name: Vanessa Sawicki
faculty.summary: Studies how attitudes and attitude strength influence behavior and interpersonal attraction, focusing on information seeking and close relationships.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究态度和态度强度如何影响行为和人际吸引力，重点关注信息寻求和亲密关系。

faculty.name: Dennis Shaffer
faculty.summary: Studies visual space and motion perception, investigating human and animal navigation and object tracking strategies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉空间和运动知觉，探究人类和动物在环境中的导航及追踪物体的策略。

faculty.name: Virginia Tompkins
faculty.summary: Studies social cognitive development in early childhood, focusing on language, literacy, and theory of mind, and their relation to social interaction with parents and teachers.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究幼儿的社会认知发展，特别是语言、文字能力和理论思维的发展及其与父母和教师互动的关系。

faculty.name: James Wirth
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of ostracism on social pain, basic human needs, mood, and aggression, and why individuals ostracize others.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究排斥对社会痛苦、基本人类需求、情绪和攻击性的影响，以及为什么个体会排斥他人。

faculty.name: Billur Akkaya
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of memory and learning in humans using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类记忆和学习的神经机制，使用神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Elisabetta Babetto
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of memory and learning, using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆和学习的神经机制，使用行为和神经影像技术。

faculty.name: Ruth Barrientos
faculty.summary: Studies how aging brain vulnerabilities, triggered by factors like infection and diet, lead to memory deficits, focusing on neuroinflammation and behavioral interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究老化大脑的脆弱性如何因感染和饮食等因素触发，导致记忆障碍，重点关注神经炎症和行为干预。

faculty.name: Eric Bourekas
faculty.summary: Studies cancers in the central nervous system using neuroimaging techniques like MRI, CT scans, and PET scans.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用神经影像技术如MRI、CT扫描和PET扫描研究中枢神经系统癌症。

faculty.name: Nam Chu
faculty.summary: Studies the role of neuronal interactions in glioblastoma progression using nanobody-based chemical biology tools and patient-derived cells.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究胶质母细胞瘤进展中的神经元相互作用，使用纳米体为基础的化学生物学工具和患者来源的细胞。

faculty.name: Jay Fournier
faculty.summary: Studies the functional neuroanatomy of depression and anxiety, identifying predictors and mechanisms of treatment response and individual differences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究抑郁和焦虑的功能神经解剖学，识别治疗反应的预测因素和机制以及个体差异。

faculty.name: Erica Glasper
faculty.summary: Studies how rewarding experiences and stressors alter brain structure and function, using multidisciplinary techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究奖励经历和应激对大脑结构和功能的影响，采用多学科技术方法。

faculty.name: Jonathan Godbout
faculty.summary: Studies the bi-directional communication between the brain and immune system, focusing on age, stress, and traumatic brain injury, and their effects on cognitive decline, anxiety, and depression.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑与免疫系统之间的双向通讯，重点关注年龄、压力和创伤性脑损伤对认知衰退、焦虑和抑郁的影响。

faculty.name: Stephanie Gorka
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of learning and memory using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用行为和神经影像技术研究学习和记忆的神经机制。

faculty.name: Tamar Gur
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of maternal mental illness on offspring psychiatric outcomes, using behavioral and molecular methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究母体精神疾病对后代精神病学结果的影响，采用行为和分子方法。

faculty.name: Martin Haesemeyer
faculty.summary: Studies how neurons interact in circuits to allow zebrafish to seek out preferred temperatures, using calcium imaging and electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究鱼类如何通过神经元电路寻找适宜温度，使用钙成像和电生理学方法。

faculty.name: Ashley Ingiosi
faculty.summary: Studies how astrocytes and neurons interact to regulate sleep using molecular, cellular, and circuit-level approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究星形胶质细胞和神经元如何相互作用以调节睡眠，使用分子、细胞和回路水平的方法。

faculty.name: Anthony King
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知和神经机制的学习与记忆，使用行为和神经影像技术。

faculty.name: Elizabeth Kirby
faculty.summary: Studies how hippocampal neural stem and progenitor cells respond to brain injury, using transgenic models and molecular biology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究海马神经干细胞和前体细胞在脑损伤中的反应，使用转基因模型和分子生物学方法。

faculty.name: Stephen Kolb
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular biology of motor neurons to develop treatments for motor neuron diseases such as spinal muscular atrophy and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动神经元的分子生物学，以开发治疗运动神经元疾病（如脊髓性肌萎缩和肌萎缩侧索硬化症）的方法。

faculty.name: Nina Kraguljac
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of learning and memory in humans, using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类学习和记忆的神经基础，使用神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Gordon Meares
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of memory and learning in humans using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类记忆和学习的神经机制，使用神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Megan Meuti
faculty.summary: Studies how mosquitoes convert environmental signals into hormonal and biochemical pathways regulating seasonal behavior, using CRISPR/Cas9 and transcriptomics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究蚊子如何将环境信号转化为激素和生物化学途径，调节季节性行为，使用CRISPR/Cas9和转录组学方法。

faculty.name: Ilaria Palmisano
faculty.summary: Studies molecular and cellular mechanisms in neuroscience.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经科学中的分子和细胞机制。

faculty.name: K. Luan Phan
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of attention and working memory in humans using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类注意力和工作记忆的神经基础，使用神经影像技术。

faculty.name: Leah Pyter
faculty.summary: Studies how cancer and cancer survival affect brain and behavior, identifying immune and endocrine pathways using mouse models and cancer patients.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究癌症及其幸存对大脑和行为的影响，通过小鼠模型和癌症患者识别免疫和内分泌途径。

faculty.name: Andrew Sas
faculty.summary: Studies brain systems for behavior using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用神经成像技术研究大脑系统对行为的作用。

faculty.name: Hillary Schiff
faculty.summary: Studies how early life taste experiences shape the maturation of taste sensory systems and feeding behaviors in mammals, using electrophysiology and genetic tools.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期味觉经验如何塑造哺乳动物味觉感觉系统和进食行为的成熟，使用电生理学和遗传工具。

faculty.name: Ivy Tso
faculty.summary: Studies behavioral neuroscience, focusing on the neural mechanisms underlying behavior and mental processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究行为神经科学，专注于行为和心理过程的神经机制。

faculty.name: Jessica Turner
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and neural mechanisms of learning and memory in humans and animals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类和动物学习和记忆的认知和神经机制。

faculty.name: Cole Vonder Haar
faculty.summary: Studies behavioral dysfunction after traumatic brain injuries, focusing on neuroinflammation and dopamine system changes, using behavioral and molecular techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究创伤性脑损伤后的行为功能障碍，重点关注神经炎症和多巴胺系统的变化，使用行为和分子技术。

faculty.name: Jason Wester
faculty.summary: Studies the development of cortical circuits in mice, focusing on the assembly of excitatory and inhibitory neurons and their synaptic physiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究小鼠皮层回路的发育，重点在于兴奋性和抑制性神经元的组装及其突触生理学。

faculty.name: Ruili Xie
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of hearing loss due to aging and noise trauma, focusing on the Endbulb of Held synapse and its pathological changes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究由于老化和噪声创伤导致的听力损失的神经机制，重点关注Endbulb of Held 突触及其病理变化。

faculty.name: Lihua Ye
faculty.summary: Studies the function and regulatory mechanisms of the gut sensory machinery and gut-brain interaction in zebrafish using genetic engineering and in vivo imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究斑马鱼肠道感觉机制及其与大脑的相互作用，使用基因工程和体内成像技术。

faculty.name: Hojjat Adeli
faculty.summary: Models brain processes and develops automated EEG-based diagnoses for neurological and psychiatric disorders using machine learning and image analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用机器学习和图像分析建模大脑过程并开发神经和精神疾病（如癫痫、阿尔茨海默病、自闭症、帕金森病和ADHD）的自动EEG诊断方法。

faculty.name: Georgia Bishop
faculty.summary: Develops educational materials and curricula for neuroscience courses, focusing on structure and function of the nervous system.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发神经科学课程的教学材料和课程，重点在于神经系统结构与功能。

faculty.name: Arnab Chakravarti
faculty.summary: Studies signal transduction pathways in glioblastomas and prostate cancer, uncovering mechanisms of radiation resistance and identifying predictive markers.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究胶质母细胞瘤和前列腺癌中的信号转导途径，揭示辐射抗性机制并鉴定预测性标记物。

faculty.name: Daniel Eiferman
faculty.summary: Studies neurotrauma and neurological disorders, exploring gene therapy approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经创伤和神经系统疾病，探索基因治疗的方法。

faculty.name: Paco Herson
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using animal models and electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用动物模型和电生理学方法。

faculty.name: Michael Kearse
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of learning and memory using pharmacological and genetic approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用药理学和遗传学方法。

faculty.name: Michael Knopp
faculty.summary: Develops advanced imaging methodologies for assessing morphology, function, and molecular pathways in the nervous system, focusing on high and ultra-high field MRI and PET/MRI.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发高级成像方法，评估神经系统形态、功能和分子途径，重点是高场和超高场MRI及PET/MRI。

faculty.name: Ulysses Magalang
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of intermittent hypoxia on adipose tissue biology, particularly adiponectin secretion, using cellular, animal, and clinical models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究间歇性低氧对脂肪组织生物学的影响，特别是对脂联素分泌的影响，使用细胞、动物和临床模型。

faculty.name: W. Jerry Mysiw
faculty.summary: Studies outcomes after traumatic brain injury and spinal cord injury, aiming to improve patient recovery.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究创伤性脑损伤和脊髓损伤后的恢复结果，旨在改善患者康复。

faculty.name: John Oberdick
faculty.summary: Studies the development and function of the cerebellum, focusing on the role of L7/Pcp2 in non-motor functions and autism, and explores drug therapies to prevent neonatal abstinence syndrome.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究小脑的发育和功能，重点关注L7/Pcp2在非运动功能和自闭症中的作用，以及探索预防新生儿戒断综合征的药物疗法。

faculty.name: John Sheridan
faculty.summary: Studies how psychosocial stressors affect gene expression in immune, behavioral, and pain responses, using a model of social defeat in mice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心理社会压力如何影响免疫、行为和疼痛反应中的基因表达，使用小鼠社会挫败模型。
